name: Being Guru

sources.title: Submit Your Idea — form with Startup Title, Startup Details, Startup Image, Full Name, Website, Email, Phone

requirements: No stated eligibility rules, pricing, or editorial criteria on the submit page
Site is Hisham Sarwar's Pakistani freelancing/tech blog; submissions land under the Startups category
Form asks for a phone number — a real contactable identity is expected
preparation: Startup title and a details/description blurb
A startup image (the form has an image upload field)
Full name, website URL, email, and phone number
workflow: Fill Startup Title, Startup Details, upload a Startup Image
Enter Full Name, Website, Email, Phone and submit
Submissions are reviewed editorially; accepted startups appear under the site's Startups category
watchFor: The batch's /submit-startu URL was truncated — the live route is /submit-startup/
This is a personal blog's contact-style form, not a structured directory; no public listing criteria or turnaround is stated
The site heavily promotes freelancing courses and hosting affiliates; the startups feature is a side channel
Don't expect a canonical 'directory listing' — acceptance likely means a blog post or category mention
countsAsLive: A post or entry naming the submitted startup appears under https://beingguru.com/category/startups/
unknowns: Whether submissions get a dedicated post or just a mention
Whether published mentions include a followed link back to the startup's website
